The '''Marine Cup Tournament''' (Japanese: '''マリンカップトーナメント''' ''Marine Cup Tournament'') is a competition in {{aniseries|BW}} that is held on a cruise ship traveling through the [[Decolore Islands]]. It is a 16-competitor tournament consisting of single [[Pokémon battle]]s that was featured in ''[[BW125|Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!]]''.

It was used by a criminal named [[Teaque]] to cover up a theft he committed. In the final round of the tournament, Teaque battled Ash and had his {{p|Galvantula}} temporally shut down the electricity on the cruise ship with {{m|Thunderbolt}}. No one accused Teaque of doing this, since it seemed like Galvantula's Thunderbolt just missed its target. With the electricity down, Teaque's Vanillite was able to steal [[Mrs. Ripple]]'s "Eye of Liepard" jewel. Meanwhile, Ash defeated Teaque and won the tournament. Teaque was later unveiled as a thief and arrested.
